title: 11. Production: Failures, Scale & Security: Failure Modes & Debugging
summary: Graph RAG systems have failure modes that span three layers: knowledge graph construction (bad extraction, missed entities), retrieval (wrong graph traversal, poor vector search), and generation (hallucination, context overflow).

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: Graph RAG systems have failure modes that span three layers: **knowledge graph construction** (bad extraction, missed entities), **retrieval** (wrong graph traversal, poor vector search), and **generation** (hallucination, context overflow). Unlike flat vector RAG, failures can cascade — a bad entity extraction creates a corrupted graph node, which leads to wrong BFS expansion, which propagates incorrect context to the LLM. Each failure has a distinct **signature** (observable symptoms), **root cause** (where in the pipeline it originates), and a **fix** at both the code level and the configuration level. Senior engineers are expected to instrument pipelines with structured logging, set alerting on key metrics (entity recall, faithfulness, latency p95), and implement automated recovery mechanisms for the most common failure patterns.

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
         GRAPH RAG FAILURE MODE TAXONOMY

  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                                                          │
  │  LAYER 1: EXTRACTION                                     │
  │  🔍 Entity miss → missing graph nodes                   │
  │  🔗 Relationship miss → disconnected graph               │
  │  🌀 Duplicates → fragmented entities                     │
  │                                                          │
  │  LAYER 2: GRAPH STRUCTURE                                │
  │  🌀 Post-merge data loss → lost relationships            │
  │  🦠 Stale community reports → wrong global answers       │
  │                                                          │
  │  LAYER 3: RETRIEVAL                                      │
  │  💥 Context overflow → LLM ignores middle entities       │
  │  🐢 Traversal timeout → partial/empty results            │
  │  🎭 Wrong mode → irrelevant context retrieved            │
  │  ⚖️ Hub bias → popular entities dominate all queries     │
  │                                                          │
  │  LAYER 4: GENERATION                                     │
  │  🧠 Hallucination → answer not grounded in graph         │
  │                                                          │
  │  LAYER 5: OPERATIONAL                                    │
  │  💸 Cost explosion → indexing budget overrun             │
  │                                                          │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  DEBUGGING FLOWCHART
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                                                             │
  │  Bad answer?                                                │
  │      │                                                      │
  │      ├─ No entities in context? → 🔍 Extraction miss       │
  │      │                                                      │
  │      ├─ No relationships in context? → 🔗 Relation miss     │
  │      │                                                      │
  │      ├─ Answer not grounded? → 🧠 Hallucination             │
  │      │                                                      │
  │      ├─ Context token count > 10K? → 💥 Overflow            │
  │      │                                                      │
  │      ├─ Same entities in every answer? → ⚖️ Hub bias        │
  │      │                                                      │
  │      ├─ Outdated facts? → 🦠 Stale summaries               │
  │      │                                                      │
  │      └─ Latency > 5s? → 🐢 Traversal timeout               │
  │                                                             │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
